visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an eye-level static shot of a narrow store entrance in an urban alley. A main character, wearing a black puffer jacket and white sneakers, is seen from behind stepping into the shop. The door is light wood with a large glass pane. Above the door, a round, warm-glowing globe lamp with the script text 'Ducks' is visible. To the left, a window display showcases various small rubber duck toys and a QR code sign. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of interior wooden shelves lined with dozens of rubber ducks in various colors and costumes. Some are themed like Japanese samurai, while others are plain yellow, red, or blue. The background is a textured grey concrete wall. (3) The camera pans across more shelves specifically showing character-themed ducks, including Minions, Batman, Stormtroopers, and RoboCop. Each duck is housed in its own small yellow or black display box with pricing labels. (4) Close-up shots feature specific novelty ducks: a DJ duck with a turntable, a Michael Jackson-themed penguin-duck, and a muscular 'Buff' duck wearing a red cape. (5) A wide shot reveals the full interior of the small shop, showing apparel like T-shirts hanging on the wall alongside pins and other merchandise. (6) A hand enters the frame holding a yellow rubber duck wearing a black beanie that says 'DUCK YOU' and extending middle fingers. (7) The duck is then shown placed on a wooden office desk next to a laptop screen displaying a website. (8) The final shot returns to the outdoor 'Ducks' globe light against a light-colored ceiling.

By utilizing high-energy music and rapid cuts to various themed ducks (Minions, Batman), it aims to highlight the store's novelty and 'cool factor' as a must-visit shopping destination.
